task: Implement #152 per docs/adr/0002-kubernetes-events-and-retry-metrics.md: emit events.k8s.io/v1 Events (option D) about per-PV quota outcomes behind --enable-events/events.enabled (default false), and add nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_retries_total{reason}/nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_backoff_seconds retry metrics.

events.summary: Maintainer decision 2026-09-05 accepted ADR-0002 option D (events.k8s.io/v1) with a per-PV/per-reason dedup window equal to syncInterval, events.enabled default false, and the RBAC rule gated on it -- issue #152's scope list and docs/adr/0002-kubernetes-events-and-retry-metrics.md's accepted Decision section.

Before this change: no code path constructed a Kubernetes Event about quota outcomes (kubectl describe pv showed nothing), and the reconcile queue's two AddRateLimited retry sites had no per-reason breakdown -- only flat reconcile_total/reconcile_errors_total counters, no signal for why a PV was retrying or how long it waited in backoff. Both gaps are documented in ADR-0002's Context section.

Change stayed scoped to the ADR: a new internal/events package, 6 wiring call sites in internal/agent (5 Event reasons + the retry-metrics helper), 2 new metrics in internal/metrics, the chart's events.enabled gate (values/daemonset/clusterrole), a dashboard panel, README/README-ko doc rows, and the Air-Gap E2E Stage C/D edits the issue's acceptance criteria named explicitly. No unrelated refactors.

Added internal/events (Recorder interface, no-op default via events.NewNoop, a real events.k8s.io/v1 EventBroadcaster-backed implementation with per-(PV,reason) dedup) wired at 5 call sites (QuotaApplied/QuotaApplyFailed/QuotaVerificationFailed in ensureQuotaMutatedWith, QuotaDrifted in syncAllQuotas' drift check, PolicyClamped at QuotaPolicy decision time, PolicyRejected in policy.go's recordEnforcement). Added nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_retries_total{reason}/nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_backoff_seconds via a new addRateLimitedWithMetrics helper that calls the rate limiter's When() exactly once (calling it twice would double-advance the exponential backoff's internal failure counter) and a new errQuotaVerificationFailed sentinel so the queue can classify verify_failed vs apply_error via errors.Is. Chart: events.enabled (default false) gates both --enable-events and the events.k8s.io create/patch ClusterRole rule, mirroring quotaPolicy.enabled's own gating pattern.

New internal/events package (Recorder interface, no-op default, real EventBroadcaster-backed implementation, dedup window unit tests) plus wiring tests in internal/agent for all 5 wired Event reasons (QuotaApplied incl. dedup-within-window, QuotaApplyFailed vs QuotaVerificationFailed distinction, PolicyClamped, PolicyRejected incl. a negative case for transient failures, QuotaDrifted), and reconcile_queue_test.go coverage for all 3 retry reasons (apply_error, verify_failed, policy_snapshot_pending) plus the backoff histogram's cumulative-bucket invariant in internal/metrics.
events.scope: Pure unit tests against fake Kubernetes clientsets and quota.SetCommandRunnerForTesting; no real quota binary or live API server is invoked. Confirms argv/wiring/classification correctness, not real-kernel enforcement or a real cluster's RBAC.

events.summary: Full build, vet, gofmt, and race-enabled test suite pass across every package; Helm chart lints, the StorageClass-RBAC-absence check stays green, an explicit events.enabled=true/false template diff shows the events.k8s.io rule is additive and correctly gated, and check-dashboard-metrics.py (extended to strip standard Prometheus histogram _bucket/_sum/_count suffixes before matching) verifies the new dashboard panel's metric names.
events.scope: Repository-wide build/static checks and rendered-chart checks; stubbed quota.CommandRunner throughout -- does not prove real prjquota host enforcement or that a real cluster's events.k8s.io API accepts these Events.

events.summary: Implementation, unit tests, chart RBAC gating, dashboard panel, README/README-ko docs, and the Air-Gap E2E script edit (events.enabled=true on install, a Stage D kubectl get events assertion for a QuotaApplied Event in the default namespace) are complete and unit/static/chart-rendering-verified. QuotaExceeded/QuotaNearLimit are declared in the Reason enum but deliberately left unwired: the only available usage read (usageForGuard) always costs a live quota-report subprocess call, which would regress the #92 performance work a regression test explicitly guards -- no cheap existing call site exists for this transition today.
events.next: Two things this trace cannot itself provide: (1) the Air-Gap E2E workflow must actually run on a real kind cluster for the new Stage D events assertion to be evidence rather than untested script text; (2) the events.k8s.io ClusterRole rule and --enable-events wiring are a privilege-widening change per AGENTS.md's High-risk paths section and need a review pass from a context that did not author it (opus review) before merge.
